head: codex/5713-runtime-v3-rcgen-local-tls
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][tls] Add stable rcgen local TLS bootstrap
body:
Closes #5713

Adds a repo-native Rust local TLS bootstrap that creates one stable rcgen self-signed identity per configured absolute developer state root and reuses it across ordinary restarts. Replacement commits an immutable certificate/key generation through one atomic current-generation manifest; changed SANs fail closed unless replacement is explicit.

The lifecycle soak now uses the shared bootstrap. Bootstrap locking uses a crash-releasing OS advisory lock. Failures are structured JSON. Unix keys are created 0600, and native Windows applies a protected current-user-only DACL before any key bytes are written. Managed external PEM material remains read-only.

Focused proof: 13/13 local TLS tests, lifecycle integration 1/1, bootstrap failure-schema unit 1/1, strict all-target Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene. GPT-5.5 exact-head review completed with zero findings. Native Windows execution remains a named pre-merge integration residual because nessus.local did not resolve during pre-PR validation; the Windows-gated ACL test is included and Linux exact-head CI is running.
